title: Checkout and Payments
seo: Secure checkout and payments for subscriptions
meta: A secure checkout page and payment methods set up with your provider, tested with real flows. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Secure checkout with the payment methods you choose
overview: We build the path from a click on Subscribe to a paid account. We set up checkout with your payment provider, using their hosted page or embedded form so card details never touch your server. You choose the payment methods, such as cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay or bank debits where available. We connect the result back to your app, so the account upgrades as soon as the payment is confirmed.

faq: Do card details pass through my server?
No. We use the provider's hosted or embedded fields, so card numbers go straight to the provider. This keeps your own compliance burden much lighter.
That depends on your provider, country and currencies. Cards and wallets are widely available. We check what your account supports before you order, and set up only what is allowed.
Can you add checkout to an app that already takes payments?
Yes. We review the current flow first, then improve or replace the checkout without touching your existing customers' subscriptions. The plan is confirmed in writing.
Do you handle money or hold funds?
No. Payments go from your customer to your own provider account. We build and test the flow, and never hold funds or request access to your bank details.
